hypothesis: COGNITION IS SUBSTANTIALLY GENETIC (population variance in cognitive ability has a large heritable component)
supporting_evidence: the repository's entire genetics base presupposes and is consistent with it: 10,741 cognition-trait associations across 4,459 mapped genes, GWAS Catalog release 2026-09-13, plus Open Targets L2G credible sets
contradictory_evidence: none in this repository
human_genetics: extensive, and POLYGENIC — the architecture is thousands of small-effect loci, which is itself the result
human_molecular: one bulk-tissue expression dataset; no QTL or colocalisation
human_intervention: not applicable — this is a claim about variance, not a target
adult_relevance: LOW — heritability of a trait says nothing about whether an adult can change it
developmental_relevance: unresolved; heritability estimates do not localise to a life stage
replication: the most replicated finding the repository touches
why: THE ONLY `SUPPORTED` ROW IN THIS TABLE — and it licenses nothing. This project did not itself test heritability; it ingested association data that presupposes it. More importantly, heritability is a statement about variance in a population, not about modifiability in an individual, and a highly heritable trait can be highly modifiable. The one hypothesis that survives is the one that cannot tell you what to do.
next_kill_test: Not worth attacking. The productive question is the next row down: whether that polygenic architecture contains any single adult-modifiable control parameter.

hypothesis: A SINGLE GENIUS GENE — one gene of large effect substantially determines cognitive ability
supporting_evidence: none
contradictory_evidence: a genome-wide sweep maps 10,741 cognition associations to 4,459 distinct genes; the strongest seed gene (CKB) appears in 5 studies and would rank outside the top 500; no gene in the repository has causal-gene attribution above level 2
human_genetics: polygenic architecture with thousands of small-effect loci — this is measured, not assumed
human_molecular: no colocalisation anywhere to nominate a dominant gene
human_intervention: not applicable
animal_causal: single-gene manipulations produce effects in animals and none has transferred to adult humans
replication: the polygenic result is replicated across every cognitive GWAS here
why: Contradicted for common variation in studied populations, which is where the data are. Stated precisely, because the strict version is NOT refuted: rare large-effect variants exist (GRIN2B de novo variants, 86 individuals), and they act in the DELETERIOUS direction and cause neurodevelopmental disorder. Large single-gene effects on cognition are real and they break things.
next_kill_test: None needed. The row exists so the project cannot drift back toward single-gene thinking without passing it.

hypothesis: EXTREME COGNITION IS QUALITATIVELY DISTINCT from ordinary-range cognition
supporting_evidence: none in this repository
contradictory_evidence: none in this repository
human_genetics: not assessed here
human_intervention: not applicable
replication: not applicable
why: ZERO ARTEFACTS. And this matters more than an empty row usually would: X01 adopted the CONTINUOUS assumption as a working constraint, taken from unverified external prose plus an unreferenced appeal to 'this repository's polygenic picture' with no claim id behind it. So the project is currently operating on an assumed answer to an unassessed question. The red team flagged this (finding f11) and it is not yet fixed.
next_kill_test: Assemble the extreme-cognition evidence map independently, or obtain the external source list. Until then the assumption should be moved out of `methodological_constraints_adopted`.

hypothesis: PYRAMIDAL-CELL SPECIFICITY — cognition-associated variation acts preferentially through excitatory pyramidal neurons
supporting_evidence: X01 reports a pyramidal association (beta ~0.097, nominal P ~0.011) — INERT, unverified, cited by nothing
contradictory_evidence: a second reported figure is P=0.08
human_genetics: cohort overlap with this repository's base is unresolvable
human_molecular: INERT — the only cell-type analysis is external_analysis_unverified, excluded from evidential classes and enforced inert by validator rule V-EXT. No evidential cell-type record exists at all
human_intervention: not applicable
replication: none; no artefacts delivered
why: Both over-readings are refused. Two nominal P-values near 0.011 are not proof that pyramidal cells are the locus; P=0.08 is not proof that they do not matter. Following X01's own methodological instruction, the discovery sweep was run CELL-CLASS-AGNOSTIC and genome-wide with no pyramidal gate — the one X01 constraint that is safe to adopt before verification, because it only widens what gets examined.
next_kill_test: An independent, verifiable cell-type enrichment with its conditioning specification and source list — enough to make cohort overlap computable.

hypothesis: SYNAPTIC BIOLOGY is the dominant locus of cognition-relevant variation
supporting_evidence: the overwhelming majority of this repository's targets and claims are synaptic — receptors, channels, plasticity machinery
contradictory_evidence: that majority is a SELECTION ARTEFACT: the seed list was supplied, and the discovery sweep found only 9 of 31 seed genes anywhere in 10,741 cognition associations, with 151 non-seed genes carrying 10 or more distinct studies
human_genetics: positional mapping implicates many non-synaptic genes (FOXO3, EXOC4, ZNF638, MMS22L, ARHGAP15) that no atlas covers
human_molecular: bulk expression only; no cell-type or QTL layer to localise anything
human_intervention: every registry-searched target is synaptic, which is circular
animal_causal: strong and synaptic — and the animal literature is itself synapse-biased
adult_relevance: synaptic mechanisms are the most plausibly adult-modifiable class, which is precisely why they were selected — and why their prevalence here is not evidence
developmental_relevance: several leading synaptic targets act developmentally
replication: not testable from a biased sample
why: This repository CANNOT currently test this hypothesis, and that is the finding. Its evidence base was assembled by selecting synaptic targets, so the preponderance of synaptic evidence measures the selection criterion. The discovery sweep is the first unbiased look and it does not support synaptic dominance — it mostly implicates genes the atlases have never examined.
next_kill_test: Pathway-annotate the 4,459 swept genes and ask whether synaptic terms are enriched above a gene-size and gene-density matched background. This is cheap and has not been done.

hypothesis: DEVELOPMENTAL WIRING — adult cognitive capacity is largely set during development
supporting_evidence: this is the repository's most persistent empirical pattern. GRIN2B: human variants act prenatally and cause neurodevelopmental disorder. RGS14: the protein is undetectable at birth and its only causal evidence is a germline knockout. OTX2 and RTN4R: critical-period mechanisms. Four red-team findings of `developmental_effect_mistaken_for_adult`
contradictory_evidence: adult-onset perturbations DO produce effects in animals (CRTC1, GPR158, HCN1, EIF2B, KL) — the adult brain is not fixed
human_genetics: the only locus-to-gene-resolved human genetics in the repository (GRIN2B de novo and rare-variant burden) is developmental and deleterious
human_molecular: the NR2B-to-NR2A switch is direct evidence that adult and juvenile synaptic biology differ
human_intervention: no adult intervention has demonstrated durable gain
animal_causal: strong for the developmental side; weaker and thinner for adult-onset
adult_relevance: THIS IS THE CRUX OF THE WHOLE PROJECT
replication: the pattern recurs across four independent targets
why: Uncomfortable for the project's premise and the evidence keeps pointing at it. Every time a target's causal evidence is examined closely, the perturbation turns out to have happened during development even when the read-out was adult. That does not prove adult capacity is fixed — adult-onset manipulations do work in animals — but the ASYMMETRY in evidence quality is real and systematic, and the project's ranking model already caps targets for it.
next_kill_test: For any leading target, an adult-onset, time-restricted perturbation with a cognitive read-out. This single design would resolve more here than any new target would.

hypothesis: ADULT SYNAPTIC CONTROL — adult cognitive capacity can be raised by modulating synaptic parameters in the adult brain
supporting_evidence: adult-inducible and adult-pharmacological animal perturbations exist for CRTC1, GPR158, HCN1, EIF2B and KL; PDE4B and CHRM1 have human cognitive results in adults
contradictory_evidence: no target has causal-gene attribution above level 2; `tier_1_analyse_next` is EMPTY; the best-evidenced human test of an adult synaptic manipulation (GABRA5) is a replicated NULL; CHRM1's supporting trial was withdrawn before enrolment over an animal toxicology finding
human_genetics: no adult-specific causal gene assignment anywhere
human_molecular: no colocalisation; nothing localises an adult mechanism
human_intervention: PDE4B (roflumilast, pan-PDE4) and CHRM1 (one unreplicated developer-affiliated secondary analysis) are the only positive adult human cognitive results, and neither is target-selective
animal_causal: present, and repeatedly shown not to transfer
comparative: mouse and rat carry 1:1 orthologues for 96% of targets, so transfer failures are NOT orthology failures — they are physiology and timing
developmental_relevance: confounds much of the supporting animal evidence
replication: no positive adult human cognitive result in this repository has replicated
why: THE PROJECT'S CENTRAL HYPOTHESIS, and after two sprints it is neither supported nor refuted. The honest summary: the adult brain is demonstrably modifiable in animals, and no one has yet shown a durable above-baseline gain in healthy adult humans from any target here. The orthology audit sharpens the diagnosis — the genes are present one-to-one in the model species, so the failure is not a missing gene but a different physiology, which is a more tractable problem.
next_kill_test: Raise any single target to causal-gene level 3 with adult human evidence. Everything downstream, including chemistry, waits on this.

hypothesis: ASTROCYTE DOMINANCE — astrocytic support, notably lactate shuttling, limits cognitive performance
supporting_evidence: the power atlas holds astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle claims and the MCT transporter family (SLC16A1/3/7)
contradictory_evidence: one paper (PMID 21376239) supplies the claims for FOUR 'separate' targets, so the apparent breadth is one source counted four times; SLC16A1 carries red-team findings of both `publication_bias` and `systemic_adverse_effects`; the ANLS model is contested in its own literature
human_genetics: SLC16A1 has monogenic human evidence; causal-gene attribution 0
human_intervention: none — the power-atlas targets carry no registry search at all and their zeros come from a Sprint-1 literature route
animal_causal: present, and concentrated in a small shared source set
replication: poor — the same few sources recur across the family
why: The clearest case in the repository of `duplicated_evidence`: three transporters and a pathway claim that look like four lines of support and are one. Nothing here refutes astrocytic involvement; there is simply much less independent evidence than the target count suggests.
next_kill_test: Run target-directed registry searches for the seven power-atlas targets, which have never had one; and count independent sources after applying convergence rule D002.

hypothesis: ENERGY DOMINANCE — metabolic supply is a binding constraint on adult cognitive performance (the COGNITIVE POWER ENVELOPE)
supporting_evidence: the power atlas: 10 interventions, 7 assessments, creatine and MCT human work, a coherent theoretical model in THEORY.md §1
contradictory_evidence: Sprint 1's own conclusion that the POWER factor MAY NOT BE LIMITING AT ALL in healthy adults — THEORY.md §1.4 is titled exactly that. Multiplicativity is declared a modelling choice, not a law
human_genetics: SLC16A1 and SLC6A8 have monogenic evidence; both are rescue-of-deficit, not enhancement
human_intervention: present for creatine; graded 2/counter 3 with a `rescue_mistaken_for_enhancement` finding
adult_relevance: adult human creatine data exist and are about repletion
replication: the rescue findings replicate; the enhancement findings do not exist
why: Downgraded by the project's own theory document before any red team touched it. The recurring pattern is that metabolic interventions help where something is DEPLETED — creatine in vegetarians, in sleep deprivation, in transporter deficiency — and do little at a healthy adult baseline. A constraint that is not binding cannot be relaxed to gain anything. This is also the finding that makes the goal-gated interface hypothesis interesting: an interface limit would still bind when no capacity is exhausted.
next_kill_test: A healthy, non-depleted, non-sleep-deprived adult baseline with a cognitive endpoint. Most existing evidence fails this design.

hypothesis: MYELIN AND NETWORK TIMING — conduction speed and temporal precision limit cognitive capacity
supporting_evidence: none in this repository
contradictory_evidence: none in this repository
human_genetics: none
human_intervention: none
adult_relevance: unknown — myelination continues into adulthood, which makes this one of the few plausibly adult-modifiable structural parameters
replication: not applicable
why: ZERO ARTEFACTS — no target, claim, atlas or state variable addresses white matter, conduction velocity or oligodendrocyte biology. This is a whole axis of cognitive neuroscience the project has simply not touched, and its absence is a selection artefact of the supplied seed list rather than a judgement. Notably, adult myelination is activity-dependent, which places it squarely inside the activity-gated mechanism class the theory nodes point at.
next_kill_test: Ask whether the swept cognition genes are enriched for oligodendrocyte and myelin annotations. The data are already in hand.
evidence_dependencies: none — this row records an absence

hypothesis: CLASSICAL NEUROMODULATOR DOMINANCE — dopaminergic, serotonergic, cholinergic and adenosinergic tone are the main levers
supporting_evidence: the largest human intervention literature in the repository by far — ADORA1 434 studies, HTR2A 316, DRD1 47, CHRM1 38 — plus the only healthy-adult human cognitive result (CHRM1)
contradictory_evidence: EVERY ONE of these targets is downgraded, and for four different reasons: ADORA1 `rescue_mistaken_for_enhancement`, DRD1 `dose_response_inversion` and `psychiatric_liability`, HTR2A `psychiatric_liability`, CHRM1 the heaviest systemic liability burden in the cohort (safety level 4) with its key trial withdrawn over animal toxicology
human_genetics: weak across all four; none above causal-gene level 0 except by positional mapping
human_intervention: by far the most-tested class in humans — and the testing has mostly not measured cognition, or has measured rescue
adult_relevance: high — these are the classes with real adult human exposure
developmental_relevance: not the main issue for this class
replication: extensive replication of clinical effects; no replicated healthy-adult cognitive enhancement
why: The most-tested hypothesis in the repository and the one with the clearest verdict: decades of human exposure, enormous trial volume, and no replicated above-baseline cognitive gain in healthy adults. The recurring failure mode is that neuromodulator manipulations move state — arousal, motivation, mood — and state changes are read as capacity changes. Where a baseline is depleted (caffeine after withdrawal) the benefit is restoration.
next_kill_test: Nothing new. The informative work is re-reading the 40 trials with posted cognitive results already sitting in the extraction queue, 51 of which belong to this class.

hypothesis: MATHEMATICAL BIOLOGY BEYOND g — mathematical ability has biology separable from general cognitive ability
supporting_evidence: 'mathematical ability' appears as a distinct trait in Open Targets L2G credible sets for CRTC1, GRIN2B and PDE4B
contradictory_evidence: those rows come from EDUCATIONAL-ATTAINMENT GWAS. CRTC1's entire human genetic grade rested on a single 'self-reported maths ability' association and was downgraded 3 to 1 by the cohort's only unresolved CRITICAL red-team finding
human_genetics: present but confounded — the trait panel marks educational attainment `use_in_ranking: proxy_only` precisely because of this
human_intervention: not assessed
animal_causal: not applicable — there is no animal model of mathematics
replication: no
why: The repository holds maths-ability associations but has never asked whether they are separable from g, and cannot: self-reported mathematical ability inside an educational-attainment GWAS is a measure of schooling, self-concept and attainment as much as of arithmetic biology. Treating it as a distinct cognitive phenotype is exactly the endpoint substitution that produced this project's only critical audit finding.
next_kill_test: Genetic correlation between a properly measured mathematical phenotype and g, in a cohort where both are directly assessed rather than self-reported.

hypothesis: ACTIVITY-GATED PLASTICITY — the useful mechanism class is one whose effect is gated by recent neural activity rather than set by exposure
supporting_evidence: synaptic tagging and capture and neuronal memory allocation are the mechanism families the theory nodes point at; CRTC1, HDAC2 and GRIN2B are the repository's bearing targets
contradictory_evidence: none — and no support either. NO TARGET IN THIS REPOSITORY HAS BEEN ASSESSED FOR ACTIVITY-GATING AT ALL
human_genetics: not assessed
human_intervention: not_measured — no study here separated prioritised from incidental material, which is the measurement this requires
animal_causal: the bearing targets have adult-onset animal evidence, none of which tested selectivity
replication: not applicable
why: This is where both project-lead theory nodes converge — SE2 'activity as the address' and C1 'gating' are the same requirement stated from opposite ends. It is also where this project came closest to fooling itself: the selective-encoding node originally used this idea to EXCLUDE tonically acting candidates as a class, which inverted its own guard and converted 'not assessed here' into 'this molecule acts tonically'. Retracted 2026-09-18. The corrected form is a measurement demand, not a filter.
next_kill_test: For any bearing target, an animal study testing whether enhancement is confined to task-engaged representations — the SE6 contrast. No such study has been identified for any target here.

hypothesis: SELECTIVE ENCODING — an enhancer should raise the contrast between prioritised and incidental encoding, not memory globally
supporting_evidence: none in this repository; the hypothesis is a specification, recorded as THEORY:selective_encoding
contradictory_evidence: none — no study in the repository measured the decisive quantity
human_genetics: none
human_intervention: not_measured — no repository study separated prioritised from incidental material
animal_causal: partially bearing: CRTC1, HDAC2, GRIN2B (SE2/SE3), none tested for selectivity
replication: not applicable — no result to replicate
why: All seven criteria SE1-SE7 are not_assessed_in_repository or partially_addressed. The hypothesis changes the MEASURED QUANTITY to a difference-in-differences, which makes most existing enhancer evidence not_assessable rather than supportive. A global memory enhancer scores zero on it however large its main effect.
next_kill_test: Find or design a study with within-session manipulation of item value, retention tested separately for prioritised and incidental items, at a consolidation-relevant delay. Absent that design, no candidate can be scored either way.

hypothesis: GOAL-GATED PLASTICITY & RETRIEVAL — cognitive capacity is limited by an imperfect interface between conscious goals and the plasticity and retrieval machinery, not only by the machinery's capacity
supporting_evidence: none in this repository; recorded as THEORY:goal_gated_plasticity_retrieval. The phenomena it appeals to (one-shot encoding under imposed salience, expert chunking, cue-triggered reconstruction) are marked appealed_to_not_verified — the repository holds no evidence for any of them
contradictory_evidence: none — `control_gap` has never been measured here
human_genetics: none
human_intervention: not_measured — and notably, the decisive test requires NO intervention
animal_causal: not applicable as posed — the claim is about volitional control
replication: not applicable — no result to replicate
why: Relocates the deficit from capacity to CONTROLLABILITY, which makes the opposite prediction about headroom: peak involuntary performance becomes a demonstration of capacity that volition cannot reach, rather than evidence of a ceiling. It separates three channels — C1 gating, C2 persistence, C3 retrieval — and the repository has NO retrieval-oriented target at all, which under this framing is a structural gap rather than an oversight. It is also a live successor to Sprint 1's finding that the POWER envelope may not be limiting in healthy adults: an interface limit would still bind when no capacity is exhausted.
next_kill_test: Estimate `control_gap` = performance under IMPOSED salience minus performance under merely INTENDED salience, matched for effort, arousal and time-on-task. Cheapest first: test whether existing study strategies already close it, which would make the hypothesis true and uninteresting.

hypothesis: 2q12.3 DUPLICATION is associated with higher cognitive performance
supporting_evidence: one CNV-GWAS association, N=258,292 (Huguet 2024, PMID 39667348), verified independently via PubMed
contradictory_evidence: none identified — and no replication either
human_genetics: CNV association only; breakpoints, carrier count and effect size all UNKNOWN to this repository; driver gene unresolved across 8 protein-coding genes in a 2 Mb cytoband
human_intervention: not applicable — a natural variant, not an intervention
adult_relevance: not stated in the retrieved source
replication: NONE — described by its authors as first-of-its-kind
why: The rarest and most valuable KIND of evidence available (a variant associated with HIGHER performance), and currently a single unreplicated association with no effect size in hand. LOEUF was recorded for the eight genes and is the WRONG METRIC — it measures loss-of-function intolerance and the variant is a duplication; triplosensitivity is the right metric and is absent.
next_kill_test: Obtain the supplementary CNV coordinates, carrier count and effect size; then ask whether the cohort overlaps this repository's existing cognitive-GWAS base, which would make it non-independent.

hypothesis: GRM3 is a cognition-relevant target
supporting_evidence: GWAS Catalog: 4 distinct studies, 5 associations, strongest p=4e-13 — independently checked in this repository
contradictory_evidence: one contributing study (PMID 30038396) is an EDUCATIONAL ATTAINMENT GWAS, not an intelligence GWAS
human_genetics: positional mapping only; causal_attribution basis gwas_association_only, locus_to_gene_resolved: no
human_intervention: none
adult_relevance: unknown — an association says nothing about when a gene acts
replication: 4 studies, but cohort overlap uncomputed; the sweep's publication set is small and heavily shared
why: Variant-level support is real and is the strongest of the three externally nominated genes. It is still positional: no causal gene, no direction, no adult mechanism. Entered the registry as an UNRANKED hypothesis.
next_kill_test: Fine-map the loci and test whether GRM3 rather than a neighbour carries the signal; and re-run the association count excluding educational-attainment studies.

hypothesis: ADGRB1 is a cognition-relevant target (nominated externally)
supporting_evidence: a gene-based claim attributed to an external analysis whose artefacts have never been delivered
contradictory_evidence: this repository's own check found ONE association, one study, p=2e-07 — BELOW the 5e-08 genome-wide threshold
human_genetics: one sub-threshold variant-level association; positional only
human_intervention: none
replication: none
why: A gene-based test can be significant where no single variant is, so the sub-threshold variant evidence does not refute the external claim. But this repository's own variant-level evidence is WEAK and must not be described as strong until the gene-based result is delivered and verified. The branch that was to deliver it does not exist.
next_kill_test: Obtain the gene-based statistic with its artefact and cohort; until then the claim is unverifiable rather than wrong.

hypothesis: PDE4B inhibition enhances adult human memory
supporting_evidence: two randomised human studies with cognitive endpoints (roflumilast, healthy young adults and 60-80s); human_intervention_evidence level 3 — the joint-highest here
contradictory_evidence: a clinical null in schizophrenia (working memory); benefit occurred at the LOWEST of three doses
human_genetics: positional GWAS; causal_gene_attribution level 1; three of four credible sets are educational attainment
human_molecular: bulk expression only; no QTL colocalisation
human_intervention: measured, positive in healthy adults; 141 registry studies, 113 tested a non-cognitive endpoint
adult_relevance: DEMONSTRATED IN ADULTS — the strongest adult evidence in the cohort
replication: two studies, same compound class, same group lineage
why: Ranks first in the cohort and still cannot be promoted. Roflumilast is a PAN-PDE4 inhibitor: as evidence about the ENDPOINT it is directly relevant, as evidence about THIS GENE it is not — which is why above_baseline_enhancement was downgraded 3->2. The dose-response inversion is unexplained and is the kind of finding that usually means the mechanism is not what it appears.
next_kill_test: A PDE4B-SELECTIVE agent with a cognitive endpoint in healthy adults. Until one exists, the gene attribution is family-level, not gene-level.

hypothesis: GABRA5 (alpha5-GABA-A) negative allosteric modulation enhances cognition
supporting_evidence: conditional CA1 deletion and NAM pharmacology in rodents; 16 independent sources, the second-largest evidence base here
contradictory_evidence: REPLICATED HUMAN NULL. Basmisanil phase 2b in CIAS: MCCB composite treatment differences -0.36 (p=0.730) and +0.28 (p=0.793). A second independently reported trial also failed. Two rodent compounds acting as POSITIVE modulators improved memory in aged rats — the opposite direction.
human_genetics: positional; causal_gene_attribution 2 / counter 2
human_intervention: MEASURED AND NULL, replicated. level 1 / counter 4 — the counter was raised by red-team audit
animal_causal: strong but contradicted (level 3 / counter 2); one rodent claim records a COST — impaired context discrimination
replication: THE NULL IS REPLICATED — two trials, not one trial reached twice
why: The most informative result in the repository, and it is negative. This is not absence of evidence; it is a PRECISE null that bounds the effect below roughly 0.2 SD in the studied population. The status says 'in studied context' deliberately: the trials were in cognitive impairment associated with schizophrenia and Down syndrome, so they do not strictly refute the mechanism in healthy adults — but nobody may cite the rodent data as though the human trials had not happened.
next_kill_test: Already run, twice. The only remaining question is whether healthy adults differ from the studied populations, and that question does not justify a new trial on this evidence.

hypothesis: HCN1 blockade enhances adult human cognition (dendritic brake)
supporting_evidence: the repository's best-covered target — facet coverage 1.00, 21 claims, 15 independent sources; adult-inducible rodent perturbation; comparative evidence assessed
contradictory_evidence: adult human layer-5 dendrites couple more weakly to the soma and carry LOWER channel density than rat, measured directly; the two direct human-versus-rodent h-current comparisons DISAGREE IN SIGN by cortical layer; adult HCN1-null mice are more seizure-susceptible
human_genetics: L2G ranks HCN1 at 2 credible sets with a COMPETING candidate gene (MRPS30) at the same loci and no QTL corroboration; causal_gene_attribution 2 / counter 2
human_intervention: none — 1 registry study, non-cognitive endpoint; the only tool compound (ZD7288) is not a clinical agent
developmental_relevance: one key knockout is forebrain-restricted but NOT time-restricted to adulthood
replication: within rodents yes; across species the sign is contested
why: The best-covered target is also the clearest case of two failures. Its comparative counter-evidence is HIGHER than its supporting level, and the human-versus-rodent dendritic difference caps translation of its strongest animal evidence. Separately, three of its five apparent evidence modalities trace to two papers, so its breadth is partly double-counting.
next_kill_test: Resolve the layer-specific sign disagreement in human tissue before any further investment; and resolve HCN1 vs MRPS30 at the credible sets.

hypothesis: RGS14 suppression enhances adult cognition (CA2 plasticity brake)
supporting_evidence: germline knockout mice show enhanced CA2 LTP and enhanced spatial and object-recognition memory
contradictory_evidence: RGS14 protein is UNDETECTABLE in mouse brain at birth and rises through the first postnatal weeks — the knockout removes it during the period it is being installed
human_genetics: measured and ABSENT — an explicit evidence_gap claim records that a systematic sweep across 22 cognitive traits returned no association
human_intervention: none — 1 registry study, non-cognitive endpoint; NO intervention record exists for RGS14 anywhere in the repository
adult_relevance: read-out is adult; the PERTURBATION is lifelong
replication: one 2010 paper supplies three claims across two atlases
why: The headline finding is the life-stage mismatch: lifelong absence of a plasticity brake during the window when it is normally installed is a DEVELOPMENTAL manipulation, and an adult test of it says nothing about blocking the protein in an adult brain. Its only human-relevant evidence is a single review presenting no human cognitive phenotype.
next_kill_test: An adult-onset, time-restricted RGS14 suppression in animals. Without it, nothing here transfers to an adult intervention.

hypothesis: CRTC1 activation enhances memory (allocation / CREB coactivation)
supporting_evidence: two adult-inducible AAV overexpression studies in mouse dentate gyrus — the cleanest ADULT-ONSET animal perturbation in the cohort
contradictory_evidence: its human genetic support was a single 'self-reported maths ability' association from an educational-attainment GWAS
human_genetics: DOWNGRADED 3->1 by a CRITICAL red-team finding; no non-education corroboration; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: NO MATCHING TRIAL FOUND — complete screen of ClinicalTrials.gov (21 records examined, 21 total). NOT a biological null: nobody has tested it, so there is nothing to have failed
replication: two studies from a closely related line of work
why: Carries the cohort's only unresolved CRITICAL red-team finding — educational attainment mistaken for intelligence — which gated its composite score. It is simultaneously the target the selective-encoding hypothesis most directly names (SE2, activity as the address) and one with essentially no human evidence. That combination is exactly what the hypothesis's guards exist to stop from becoming a promotion.
next_kill_test: Any human genetic association with a NON-EDUCATION cognitive measure; and an animal study measuring whether enhancement is confined to task-engaged representations (the SE6 test).

hypothesis: GPR158 antagonism enhances adult cognition
supporting_evidence: germline knockout, ADULT-INDUCIBLE genetic perturbation, and an osteocalcin-CA3 memory pathway in aged animals
contradictory_evidence: THE DIRECTION IS UNRESOLVED: one literature makes GPR158 an excitability brake (suppress it), another makes it the receptor for a memory-PROMOTING hormone (preserve it). One of its two level-3 genetic records is an MTAG combining education and intelligence.
human_genetics: positional plus one L2G credible set on intelligence; causal_gene_attribution 2
human_intervention: not_measured — 33 registry studies, 29 tested a non-cognitive endpoint; human_intervention_evidence level 0
animal_causal: present including adult-inducible; above_baseline_enhancement level 0 / counter 1
replication: no
why: Deprioritised by audit for overclaiming. A target whose DESIRABLE DIRECTION OF MANIPULATION is unknown cannot be a candidate, whatever its evidence volume — you cannot design an intervention when agonism and antagonism are both defensible.
next_kill_test: Resolve the direction: an adult-onset manipulation that measures cognition while distinguishing the brake role from the osteocalcin-receptor role.

hypothesis: EIF2B / integrated stress response modulation enhances adult memory
supporting_evidence: ISRIB-class adult PHARMACOLOGICAL perturbation in rodents; an ADULT-ONSET human monogenic disease (vanishing white matter, 33 genetically confirmed patients) — the complex's only locus-to-gene-resolved human record
contradictory_evidence: two terminated fosigotifator trials (ALS, major depressive disorder) that no atlas had recorded until the red team found them
human_genetics: monogenic disease only; NO GWAS-level support; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: not_measured — 6 registry studies, all non-cognitive endpoints. The ALS platform trial specified ALSFRS, NOT a cognitive endpoint, so it is an evidence_gap and explicitly NOT a clinical null
adult_relevance: adult-onset human disease; adult rodent pharmacology
developmental_relevance: one knockout is developmental, read out in adults
replication: no human cognitive test has been run
why: Mechanistically the best-motivated candidate for converting transient encoding into a durable trace (SE3), and the one where the human cognitive question has simply never been asked. Its retyping from clinical_null to evidence_gap is the correct call and matters: a trial that never measured cognition cannot have failed at it. Tractability is the only 'not_assessed' in the cohort.
next_kill_test: Any ISR-modulating agent with a cognitive primary endpoint in adults. The two terminated trials tell us about ALS and depression, not memory.

hypothesis: EIF2S1 (eIF2alpha) modulation enhances adult memory
supporting_evidence: conditional developmental knockout and in-vitro pharmacodynamics
contradictory_evidence: none directly — the problem is absence, not contradiction
human_genetics: MEASURED AND ABSENT — an explicit evidence_gap claim records a systematic sweep of GWAS Catalog across 22 cognitive traits and of Open Targets L2G returning no association
human_intervention: not_measured — 10 registry studies, none with a cognitive endpoint
animal_causal: developmental conditional knockout only; adult_onset_perturbation level 0
developmental_relevance: the only causal evidence is developmental
replication: no
why: Audited as insufficient_evidence with zero contradicted facets — nothing is wrong with it, there is simply not enough. It also should not be counted as independent support for the ISR hypothesis: EIF2S1 and EIF2B_COMPLEX are the SUBSTRATE and the GEF of one pathway and share their mechanistic rationale.
next_kill_test: An adult-onset perturbation with a cognitive read-out. The developmental knockout cannot answer the adult question.

hypothesis: Klotho (KL) elevation enhances adult and aged cognition
supporting_evidence: human observational association with executive function; mouse overexpression; administration in AGED NON-HUMAN PRIMATES; adult_onset_perturbation level 3
contradictory_evidence: DOSE-RESPONSE INVERSION — benefit at a low dose and NONE at a high dose in primates, on a study with a commercially interested author. A 527-person cohort found the same KL-VS variant reported as protective elsewhere associated in the OPPOSITE direction. Its lead claim is flagged `contested`.
human_genetics: MEASURED AND ABSENT on the cognitive panel (explicit evidence_gap claim); support is candidate-variant association only; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: A completed early-phase-1 study in 14 adults aged 50-80 DOES exist (NCT07285629) with five NIH Toolbox cognitive secondary outcomes — NO RESULTS POSTED. Graded 0, and the grading reasons are recorded so a later agent can disagree with them
animal_causal: mouse and non-human primate; above_baseline_enhancement 2 / counter 3
adult_relevance: adult and aged throughout — its strongest feature
replication: contradicted rather than replicated in human cohorts
why: The adult-relevance profile is the best in the cohort and the evidence quality does not match it. A non-monotonic dose response with a conflicted author, plus an opposite-direction human cohort, is the signature of a finding that will not replicate. Its stated mechanism is synaptic and glutamatergic, which does not link it to any power-domain state variable the atlas placed it in.
next_kill_test: The posted results of NCT07285629; and an independent replication of the KL-VS cognitive association in a cohort that did not generate it.

hypothesis: CHRM1 (M1 muscarinic) agonism enhances adult human cognition
supporting_evidence: THE REPOSITORY'S ONLY HEALTHY-ADULT HUMAN COGNITIVE RESULT — HTL0018318 improved working memory in 36 healthy young and 50 healthy elderly adults; xanomeline efficacy in Alzheimer's; adult_expression_and_timing level 3
contradictory_evidence: the phase 2 of that very compound was WITHDRAWN BEFORE ENROLLING ANYONE, pending an unexpected animal toxicology finding. 52% of patients in a high-dose arm discontinued for adverse events. A clinical-harm meta-analysis. M1-null mice show a BIDIRECTIONAL phenotype including normal or enhanced memory on some tasks.
human_genetics: MEASURED AND ABSENT on the cognitive panel; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_molecular: bulk expression only; the largest human M1 dataset by sample size measured NO cognitive endpoint at all — a gap, not a null
human_intervention: MEASURED AND POSITIVE in healthy adults, level 3, but the result is a single exploratory, unreplicated, developer-affiliated secondary analysis carrying three facets
adult_relevance: healthy young and elderly adults — the cleanest adult relevance here
replication: NONE — one secondary analysis
why: Carries the heaviest systemic liability burden in the cohort (safety level 4: the full peripheral cholinergic toxidrome plus liver-failure annotations, corroborated by 52% discontinuation) and is the only target gated on safety alone. The single most promising human cognitive result in the repository sits on top of a withdrawn trial and a toxicology signal.
next_kill_test: The outcome of the toxicology investigation, and any replication of the healthy-adult working-memory effect by a non-affiliated group.

hypothesis: GRIN2B (NR2B) elevation enhances adult human cognition
supporting_evidence: forebrain NR2B overexpression enhances rodent memory across three claims; 19 claims total
contradictory_evidence: HUMAN VARIANTS IN THE SAME GENE CAUSE NEURODEVELOPMENTAL DISORDER — 86 individuals with de novo pathogenic variants, plus a rare-variant burden result, both locus-to-gene-resolved and both in the DELETERIOUS direction
human_genetics: the only target here with resolved rare-variant human genetics — and it is developmental and deleterious; GWAS is positional, L2G sets are educational attainment and mathematical ability; causal_gene_attribution 1
human_molecular: bulk expression; the NR2B-to-NR2A developmental switch is itself evidence that adult and juvenile biology differ
human_intervention: not_measured for enhancement — 257 registry studies, 141 with non-cognitive endpoints, 17 completed-unreported reporting gaps, 27 with posted results awaiting extraction
animal_causal: strong (level 3 / counter 2) but adult_onset_perturbation only level 1
adult_relevance: animal read-out is adult; the manipulation is constitutive
developmental_relevance: HIGHEST RISK — developmental_confound_risk level 3; the human genetics is prenatal and postnatal-developmental
replication: rodent enhancement replicated; human direction is opposite
why: The repository's CLEAREST life-stage mismatch. Constitutive developmental overexpression enhances rodent memory while human variants in the same gene cause neurodevelopmental disorder. Both can be true — dose and direction and timing differ — but the animal result cannot be cited as adult human evidence.
next_kill_test: Adult-onset, time-restricted NR2B elevation with a cognitive read-out and a safety assessment; and extraction of the 27 trials with posted results already in the queue.

hypothesis: HDAC2 inhibition enhances adult memory (transcriptional gating)
supporting_evidence: germline knockout and acute circuit perturbation in adult rats; adult_onset_perturbation level 2
contradictory_evidence: trichostatin A enhanced an intermediate phase of LTP but had NO EFFECT on persistence — the property SE3 actually requires. A phase 2a null (FRM-0334) — on a MOLECULAR readout, not cognition
human_genetics: MEASURED AND ABSENT on the cognitive panel; L2G support is educational-attainment-only; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: not_measured — 159 registry studies, 117 non-cognitive endpoints. The four terminations are ADMINISTRATIVE (recruitment, staffing, mis-registration), not mechanism failures
adult_relevance: adult rodent and adult human records
replication: no
why: Liability is INHERITED FROM THE ONCOLOGY HDAC-INHIBITOR CLASS — thrombocytopenia, hepatotoxicity, fatigue, hypoacusis — while target-level annotation returns nothing, so the safety picture looks cleaner at the gene than it is in practice. The trichostatin result is the more interesting problem: potentiation that decays is not enhancement.
next_kill_test: An HDAC2-selective agent (not a pan-inhibitor) with a persistence endpoint at a consolidation-relevant delay.

hypothesis: GRM5 (mGluR5) modulation enhances cognition
supporting_evidence: animal causal evidence and positional human genetics (causal_gene_attribution 2)
contradictory_evidence: AFQ056 in 148 adults with fragile X: study treatment FAILED to demonstrate efficacy. Carries a CRITICAL model_organism_translation_failure finding
human_genetics: positional; causal_gene_attribution 2 / counter 2
human_intervention: MEASURED AND NULL in the studied population; level 0 / counter 3
animal_causal: present and strongly contradicted by the human result
developmental_relevance: fragile X is a developmental condition
replication: the mGluR5 programme failed broadly across sponsors
why: One of the most-cited model-to-human translation failures in neuroscience: a mechanism with excellent mouse data that did not transfer. Deprioritised by audit with its composite gated by an unresolved critical finding.
next_kill_test: None warranted on current evidence. The informative work is post-mortem: WHY the mouse-to-human transfer failed, since that lesson generalises to other targets here.

hypothesis: OTX2 modulation reopens adult plasticity
supporting_evidence: developmental critical-period biology; human_genetic_association level 3
contradictory_evidence: a major developmental_effect_mistaken_for_adult finding; gated by developmental_confound_caps_d2
human_genetics: level 3 association but causal_gene_attribution 1; no signal in the current Open Targets release
human_intervention: NO MATCHING TRIAL FOUND — complete screen (2 records examined, 2 total). Nobody has tested it
adult_relevance: the core problem — the biology is a CRITICAL-PERIOD mechanism
replication: not applicable
why: Deprioritised by audit. Critical-period biology describes how plasticity CLOSES during development; reopening it in an adult is a different intervention with different risks, and the developmental evidence does not license it.
next_kill_test: An adult-onset manipulation demonstrating reopened plasticity WITHOUT loss of stability — SE7 in the selective-encoding framing.

hypothesis: RTN4R (Nogo receptor) blockade reopens adult plasticity
supporting_evidence: animal causal evidence only — the sole modality it has
contradictory_evidence: a major developmental_effect_mistaken_for_adult finding
human_genetics: none on the cognitive panel; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: NO MATCHING TRIAL FOUND — complete screen (15 records examined, 15 total)
animal_causal: present — and it is the ONLY evidence modality for this target
replication: no
why: One of three targets resting on a SINGLE evidence modality after the convergence correction. Animal-only evidence for a developmental mechanism is the weakest configuration in the repository.
next_kill_test: Any human evidence of any kind.

hypothesis: ADORA1 (adenosine A1) antagonism enhances cognition
supporting_evidence: animal causal work and a large human intervention literature (caffeine and relatives); level 2
contradictory_evidence: a major RESCUE-MISTAKEN-FOR-ENHANCEMENT finding — reversing a deficit is not raising a healthy baseline; counter level 3
human_genetics: none; causal_gene_attribution 0
human_intervention: the largest registry footprint in the repository — 434 studies, 323 with non-cognitive endpoints, 37 COMPLETED-UNREPORTED reporting gaps, 3 with posted results awaiting extraction
replication: extensive, and mostly on the wrong question
why: The clearest case of restoration being read as enhancement: most human adenosine cognitive data compares caffeine against a withdrawn or sleep-deprived baseline, which measures rescue. It also has the repository's largest reporting-gap burden — 37 completed trials with cognitive outcomes in protocol and nothing posted. This is the ONLY target whose registry screen remains partial (1,000-record cap).
next_kill_test: A non-withdrawn, non-sleep-deprived healthy-adult baseline with a cognitive endpoint; and retrieval of the 37 unreported results.

hypothesis: CONVERGENCE — the repository's targets are supported by multiple independent evidence modalities
supporting_evidence: before correction, all 27 targets appeared in two or more modalities and several in five
contradictory_evidence: after removing double-counting, NO target exceeds THREE independent modalities, and three targets rest on animal evidence alone
human_genetics: largely one or two cohorts; UK Biobank recurs under many source ids
human_molecular: ONE GTEx v8 bulk-tissue run populates the column for essentially every target
human_intervention: present for 20 of 27; power-atlas targets were searched by a different route and carry no A-G code
animal_causal: the most widely present modality, and the least transferable
replication: seven distinct double-counting mechanisms identified and verified
why: The apparent breadth was an artefact of filing one observation in two places: atlas facet grades counted beside the claims they are computed FROM, one expression dataset counted per target, GWAS Catalog and Open Targets L2G counted as two observations of the same summary statistics, and null trials counted as a separate modality. The correction removes a modality precisely from the best-evidenced targets.
next_kill_test: Build the convergence scorer and the validator rule. The rules are encoded but NOT enforced, so the double-counts can be reintroduced with nothing firing.

hypothesis: COMPARATIVE CONVERGENCE — mechanisms recruited independently in cognitively specialised lineages are general requirements of cognition
supporting_evidence: none — no selection scan or convergence analysis has been run
contradictory_evidence: not applicable
human_genetics: not applicable
human_intervention: not applicable
comparative: PANEL DEFINED, ANALYSIS NOT RUN. 11 of 13 non-human panel species have orthology available in Ensembl Compara
replication: not applicable
why: BOTH avian convergence candidates — New Caledonian crow and budgerigar — are absent from Ensembl Compara, while BOTH avian controls — chicken and zebra finch — are present. The available birds are the uninformative ones, so a scan would return a null for birds that is absence of MEASUREMENT of the specialised species. Octopus, the most independent lineage available anywhere, sits in a different resource entirely. Trait covariates are deliberately not ingested rather than recalled.
next_kill_test: An orthology resource covering corvids and parrots. Without one, the avian arm is inoperable and no avian statement may be made in either direction.

hypothesis: EXTREME COGNITION provides evidence about enhancement mechanisms
supporting_evidence: none
contradictory_evidence: not applicable
human_genetics: none
human_intervention: none
replication: not applicable
why: ZERO ARTEFACTS. No claim, source, assessment or target record exists. The only trace in the repository is an outstanding deliverable attributed to a branch that the branch audit establishes DOES NOT EXIST. This is a gap, not a null, and it is the largest single hole in the evidence base.
next_kill_test: Obtain the source list, or build the evidence map independently.

hypothesis: X01 — cell-type enrichment implicates specific neuronal populations
supporting_evidence: an external analysis reporting a pyramidal-cell association (beta ~0.097, nominal P ~0.011) in one dataset
contradictory_evidence: a second reported figure is P=0.08, which is not evidence of absence any more than P=0.011 is proof of presence
human_genetics: cohort overlap with this repository's genetics base is UNRESOLVABLE pending a source list
human_molecular: INERT — provenance_class external_analysis_unverified, excluded from evidential_classes and enforced inert by validator rule V-EXT
human_intervention: not applicable
replication: none; no artefacts delivered
why: Recorded verbatim, cited by nothing, and mechanically prevented from supporting any claim, facet or assessment. Two nominal P-values near 0.011 are not proof, and P=0.08 is not a demonstration that pyramidal cells do not matter. Two of its METHODOLOGICAL instructions were adopted as safe before verification (no pyramidal-only gate; extreme cognition treated as continuous) because they only ever WIDEN what gets examined.
next_kill_test: Delivery of the artefacts named in the handoff contract, with the source list that would make cohort overlap resolvable.

hypothesis: Any current target is ready for chemistry, docking or a lead compound
supporting_evidence: none
contradictory_evidence: highest causal-gene attribution anywhere in the cohort is 2; 17 of 27 seed targets sit at level 0; tier_1_analyse_next is EMPTY; zero molecular-QTL colocalisation repository-wide
human_genetics: no target has a defensible adult causal gene assignment
human_molecular: no colocalisation anywhere — measured and absent (70/70 L2G records)
human_intervention: the best human evidence is a replicated NULL (GABRA5)
animal_causal: strong and repeatedly shown not to transfer
adult_relevance: no target has demonstrated adult causal control
developmental_relevance: several leading targets are developmental mechanisms
replication: not applicable
why: This row exists to be cited when the question is asked. Virtual pharmacology remains gated, and the gate is not procedural caution — it is that no target has a causal gene assignment strong enough to design against. Docking a molecule into a protein this repository cannot show is the right protein would produce confident output with no epistemic content.
next_kill_test: Raise ANY target to causal-gene level 3 with adult human evidence. Nothing downstream is justified before that.
